mails.subject: End Semester Examination Schedule - Winter 2026
mails.originalContent:
Dear Students,

This is to inform all students that the End Semester Examinations for Winter 2026 will commence from March 15, 2026. The detailed timetable will be uploaded on the university portal by February 20, 2026.

Please note the following:
1. Admit cards will be available for download from March 1, 2026
2. Students with any outstanding dues must clear them before February 28, 2026
3. The examination will be conducted in offline mode
4. Seating arrangements will be displayed outside examination halls one day prior

For any queries, contact the Examination Cell at exams@university.edu

Best regards,
Controller of Examinations
mails.summary: End Semester Exams start March 15, 2026. Timetable releases Feb 20. Clear dues by Feb 28. Admit cards available from March 1.
actionItems: Check portal for timetable on Feb 20
Clear any pending dues before Feb 28
